summary: Bundled SSH private key grants shared access to author's build server
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in CONFIG.encodedSSHKey. When the user invokes the CLI (rx signup/login/deploy), the key is decoded, written to a temp file with 0600 permissions, and used to `ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ubuntu@79.72.65.161` to run server-side scripts (auth.sh, build.sh, make-key.sh) on the author's build server. The credential is shared: every installer receives the same key and can log in as user `ubuntu` on 79.72.65.161. There are no install lifecycle hooks, and the SSH connection only fires when the user explicitly runs a CLI subcommand. The installer's machine is not scanned, no installer credentials are collected, and no data from the installer is exfiltrated — the exposed asset is the author's own server.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
